newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end year's final session firmer.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end year's final session firmer.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures ended slightly firmer in Friday's half-day year-end session, lifted by short-covering ahead of the close, traders said.
Prices were 10 to 200 yen higher, with the benchmark January 1998 contract up 30 yen at 14,360 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 29,882 lots.
The market started the day generally weaker as prices received little support from the Chicago market overnight, but year-end short-covering helped reverse early losses.
Activity was basically directionless. Trading will resume on January 6.-- Tokyo Commodity Desk (81-3-3432-7391)
